profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform enables enterprises to discover AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. According to its website, Credo AI created the AI governance category and is now defining it for the agentic era, using a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context.

The company's core product, Credo AI, is a purpose-built AI governance platform with ready-to-deploy policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards. The platform includes native integrations across existing stacks and features GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), which the company says compresses weeks of governance work into hours. Credo AI also offers model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in one system, with agents treated as first-class governed entities that are registered, risk-assessed, sanctioned, and governed.

The platform is used by enterprises including Mastercard, IBM, and organizations in insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare sectors. The company's policy packs were written by team members involved in creating AI governance standards at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD.
